description: Bespoke classical-to-adelic dictionary translator for the automorphic-forms-adelic topic. A single select dropdown lets the reader pick a classical object (modular form, Hecke operator, level structure) and the readout displays its adelic counterpart. The select-only-no-svg single-translator-card shape is one-off and does not fit any existing form or input slug.
